decisions.reason: Although this service is close to the firm’s existing capabilities and thus fits its strong absorptive capacity, it is only mentioned rather than prominently developed on the website and may be vulnerable to rationalisation because of overlap with other express programs.

The 72-hour express program builds directly on the firm’s established production, logistics, and service knowledge, so a large firm with in-house R&D is likely to keep refining it despite the operational strain of such a fast offer.
An express delivery program for doors and gates is very close to the core business and its continued own-page presentation suggests the firm has learned how to commercialise it successfully.

The online ordering and digital services platform extends the existing offer in a way that complements the firm’s advisory and service model, and with in-house R&D the firm is well placed to improve and integrate it rather than abandon it.
This product is highly related to the firm’s established technical and regulatory knowledge, and its upgrade from a mention to its own page indicates growing commitment and positive learning effects.
